itemSnapshots.BC-006: {"status":"READY","progress":20,"title":"Implement user management CRUD","description":"Complete user persistence, application services, and REST endpoints so trainers can register, view, update, deactivate, and list users without exposing passwords.","scope":"`build.gradle.kts`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`, `src/main/resources/db/migration/V3__Add_Users_Table.sql`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["`POST /api/v1/users` returns `201 Created` for valid input and never serializes a password","A duplicate email returns `409 Conflict` and does not create a second user","Passwords are persisted as BCrypt hashes and are never stored in plain text","`GET /api/v1/users/{id}` returns `404 Not Found` for an unknown identifier","`Email`, `Password`, and `PhoneNumber` reject invalid values through their domain invariants","Unit, `@WebMvcTest`, and `@DataJpaTest` coverage exists for the implemented user flows"]}
itemSnapshots.BC-007: {"status":"READY","progress":0,"title":"Implement stateless JWT authentication","description":"Add login and registration authentication with signed, expiring JWTs and protect API endpoints through Spring Security.","scope":"`build.gradle.kts`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/config/security/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/auth/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/config/security/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["Valid credentials at `POST /api/v1/auth/login` return `200 OK` with a signed JWT","Registration reuses public `POST /api/v1/users`, which creates `GUEST` users","Invalid credentials return `401 Unauthorized`","Protected endpoints return `401 Unauthorized` without a valid token","A valid token with an allowed role reaches the protected endpoint, while an insufficient role returns `403 Forbidden`","Expired or invalidly signed tokens return `401 Unauthorized`","JWT claims include the username, roles, and expiration timestamp","MockMvc integration tests cover public, authenticated, forbidden, and expired-token requests"]}
itemSnapshots.BC-008: {"status":"READY","progress":0,"title":"Add roles and granular authorities","description":"Persist roles and authorities and apply them to API operations so access is controlled by explicit permissions.","scope":"`src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/config/security/`, `src/main/resources/db/migration/V4__Add_Roles_Authorities.sql`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["`ROLE_GUEST`, `ROLE_STAFF`, and `ROLE_ADMIN` are persisted and loaded into the security context","Authorities include user read/write, hotel management, and reservation creation permissions","A guest can read hotels but cannot create or modify them","Staff can manage reservations and administrators retain access to all declared operations","Flyway seeds are idempotent and the user-to-role relationship is persisted","Authorization tests cover every declared role and protected endpoint combination"]}
itemSnapshots.BC-009: {"status":"READY","progress":0,"title":"Establish layered feature testing","description":"Establish a repeatable test strategy for hotels and users across domain, web, persistence, integration, and end-to-end boundaries.","scope":"`src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/hotels/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/support/`","type":"tech-debt","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["Hotels and users each have unit, controller, and full-context integration coverage","Repository behavior is covered with `@DataJpaTest` where persistence is used","End-to-end tests use the configured Testcontainers PostgreSQL path when Docker is available","Unit tests execute without a Spring context and each test completes in less than 100 ms on the test runner","Tests use isolated fixtures and pass reproducibly in two consecutive runs","Scenario names follow `debe_resultado_cuando_condicion` or an equivalent documented convention"]}
